criteria.aspect: For each actual scope, state one controlling thesis; keep other applicable perspectives as explicit support or constraints rather than a toothless average. Separate independent tasks rather than forcing one global winner.
criteria.context: Let the actual user/actor goal and acceptable tradeoffs control the situated judgment while facts still constrain it. Do not invent purchase timing or erase legitimate preferences.
criteria.frame: Check whether the problem is framed at the right level. Preserve valid local truth, but do not let it decide a broader claim without support. Do not disagree just to display skepticism.
criteria.none: No special cognitive perspective is needed.
criteria.root: When evidence establishes the broken canonical cause, replace that rule at its owner with intended behavior and verify downstream impact. When it is only a hypothesis, preserve uncertainty and obtain evidence.
criteria.spiral: Recheck the original goal, actual progress and expected value before another same-path repair. Prefer subtraction or upstream correction when supported; ordinary useful iteration is not a reason to stop.
criteria.whole: Identify the actual object, the mechanism and what controls success/failure before deciding whether a reduction is sufficient. Accept a truly sufficient simple explanation; do not invent extra machinery.
